value.answer: Assuming you mean Oakville, Ontario: there's no open Costco there yet. One is coming on Wyecroft Rd near Burloak Dr, and the latest reports say fall 2027. For now the closest one is probably the Laird Rd warehouse at 3180 Laird Rd in Mississauga, which a deals site says also serves Oakville. Burlington has one too, but I don't have its address. I can't tell how far any of them is from you.
